method_rules: A reconciliation value requires the same country, year, pillar, product definition, sales channel and valuation basis. Null means unresolved, never zero.
No three-method average or twofold comparison is computed while compatible values are missing.
Imports are not independent finished-product market sizes: domestic production, exports, stock changes, re-exports, nonfood use and transformation remain unknown.
The specified HS categories do not separate plant-based, fermentation and cultivated final consumer sales. Product-level classification and end-use evidence are required.
Plant-based questionnaire sales are retail; other pillars include foodservice. Human-food matching shares exclude pet food even when questionnaire cultivated sales include it.
Do not sum overlapping pillars, multiply product counts by speculative sales, infer zero from no approval found, or infer Indian/Pakistani revenue from global segment revenue.
